points.quote: Create the decorator with `createDecorator<IFooService>('fooService')`, and give it the same name as the interface: `export const IFooService = createDecorator<IFooService>('fooService');`.
Constructor injection: put the service parameter after any non-service arguments and mark it with the decorator: ... `@IFooService private readonly fooService: IFooService,`

Creating injectable objects: call `instantiationService.createInstance(MyClass, arg)`. ... Contributions, such as workbench contributions, are created through `createInstance`, so they receive injection too.
Singleton registration is a side-effect import, so the file must be pulled in by an entry-point `import`.
